SELECTED_INDEX: 2
CONFIDENCE: 0.76
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a single carbonyl band at 1711 cm⁻¹, consistent with a ketone C=O and incompatible with imines (1,6), amides (3; would also show N–H near 3300 cm⁻¹), aldehydes (5,7,9,10; would show aldehydic C–H near 2720–2820 cm⁻¹), or an OH-bearing hydroxyketone (8; no O–H stretch observed). Strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2870–2954 cm⁻¹ support a saturated aliphatic framework (GFQ-003). CH2 bending at 1454/1425 cm⁻¹ and multiple skeletal/ring modes at 1116, 1075, 1020, 994, 843, 754, and 657 cm⁻¹ are consistent with a cyclohexanone ring. Overall, cyclohexanone (2) best matches the observed Raman features.
